items.name: export-to-csv
items.title: exportToCSV + toCsvString
items.description: Lightweight client-side CSV export. RFC-4180 escaping (quotes, commas, newlines), configurable delimiter, UTF-8 BOM so Excel detects encoding correctly. Triggers a download or returns the string.

items.name: export-to-excel
items.title: exportToExcel (lazy-loaded xlsx)
items.description: Excel export that lazy-loads the xlsx library (~430KB) only when called — keeps it out of the initial bundle per the framework's LAZY LOADING rule. Column widths, type hints (string/number/date), bold header row.

items.name: print-button
items.title: PrintButton + usePrint
items.description: Print button + scoped print-stylesheet hook. Print the whole page, or pass `targetId` to print only one element via a temporary @media print rule. Cleans up the stylesheet after `afterprint`.
